scope: Curated source-supported catalog, not an exhaustive manufacturer catalog or compliance certification database.

data_policy.null_meaning: Not applicable OR not transcribed/confirmed; consult field_notes. Never interpret null as zero, false, unrestricted, or compliant.
data_policy.translations: Italian, French and Arabic descriptions are editorial translations, not manufacturer-approved localized catalog text.
data_policy.pricing: No prices invented. All pricing is null pending a current, currency-specific supplier quote.
data_policy.regional_tags: Editorial library organization only, not proof of availability or certification.
data_policy.standards: Product standards are distinct from installation standards and certification marks.
data_policy.rotation: Null rotation permissions mean unknown, not unrestricted.
data_policy.verification_limit: Official web pages may contain errors or change. Dataset is not a guarantee of 100% accuracy; current manufacturer datasheet, certificate scope, supplied SKU and local requirements must be verified before procurement or installation.
data_policy.numeric_contract: Physical quantities are JSON numbers or null; voltage ranges use explicit numeric min/max fields. Numeric strings and booleans are forbidden. SKUs and EANs remain strings.
data_policy.calculation_scope: This is a component catalog, not a voltage-drop model. Cable length, conductor area/material, resistance/reactance, temperature, load current, phase configuration and power factor must be provided separately. Rated component current is not design/load current.
data_policy.standard_mapping: standard is normalized for querying; standard_as_published preserves the source label. IEC/EN 60898-1 and IEC/EN 60947-2 are different rating systems, not exclusive installation-sector permissions.
data_policy.i18n_contract: translations.<it|fr|en|ar>.{name,description}; all four required. Text is editorial, not official localization.
data_policy.datasheet_contract: datasheet_url is an official direct PDF if identified; otherwise null. Family catalogs are marked family_catalog. Linked does not mean certificate validity verified.

installation_rules_context: NF C 15-100 series (applicable edition and project scope to be established)
FR.note: EN/IEC conformity does not alone establish an NF mark. catalog_marks records only marks/certificate links displayed by the manufacturer.
